name: GIRDER 格拉德 Dash Pro 2025 Dura-Ace Di2
why_interesting: GIRDER's top current lightweight all-round road complete, with Dura-Ace Di2 R9270, Adler Augen 40 mm carbon wheels and a 7.38 kg claim at an official ¥30,800.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Dura-Ace Di2 R9270 2×12; FC-R9200 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R9200 11-34T cassette, CN-M9100 chain
facts.frame: 2025 DASH Toray T800 + T1000 lightweight all-round carbon frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, UDH dropout, fully hidden routing
facts.frame_material: Toray T800 + T1000 carbon frame (reinforced bottom-bracket area) and fork; lay-up is not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded frame and fork with fully hidden cable routing
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found; the reinforced bottom-bracket wording is manufacturer construction copy, not a test result
facts.bottom_bracket: Threaded BSA per manufacturer; the page lists '68mm/73mm' shell widths without saying which applies, so confirm the shell before ordering parts
facts.wheels: Adler Augen unpainted Golden Eagle carbon wavy-rim wheels, 40 mm, ceramic-bearing hubs, Sapim spokes
facts.tires: Maxxis 700C×28C folding tires fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: Adler Augen integrated carbon handlebar, unpainted 3K finish
facts.geometry: Official chart (shared by the DASH and BISON pages), stack/reach mm for listed sizes: 440 500/366, 490 514/375, 520 527/380, 540 545/384; seat angle 75.5–74°, head angle 70.5–73°, chainstay 410 mm, wheelbase 970–980 mm. The chart also lists 560 and 580 rows that the page does not offer and leaves BB drop blank.
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated

missing: Exact bottom-bracket shell width (page lists 68 mm/73 mm)
Complete-weight size, pedal and measurement basis
Independent exact-model stiffness or deflection measurement
Current mainland marketplace listing or checkout amount, warranty issuer, warranty term and invoice handling

official_price.price_basis: Manufacturer-listed price on the exact NEW 2025 DASH PRO page; no mainland marketplace listing or checkout amount was observed

source_note: Official NEW 2025 DASH PRO page; GIRDER sells by direct inquiry and no mainland marketplace listing was verified. See docs/research-girder-range-inventory-2026-10-24.md for related generations kept separate.
price_status: Official CNY 30,800 list price observed 2026-10-24; no marketplace listing or checkout amount verified
